answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent networks by tying identity weight to bonded capital. To forge identities, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens, an endeavor as arduous as mining ferrous ore from deep shale. Once the network reaches equilibrium, the capital cost of maintaining multiple fraudulent nodes yields no nectar of profit, effectively rendering decentralized consensus immune to zero-cost identity inflation through prohibitive economic barriers.
